en_title: PlayStation 6 RAM and Storage Alone May Cost $680, According to Leaker
cn_title: 曝PS6内存与存储成本超整台PS5
subtitle: 售价恐难乐观
opus_summary: 爆料者称，PS6仅内存与存储成本就超过整台PS5，并曾因内存危机上调物料成本预估。这些数字仍待证实，索尼尚未公布这款主机，也未正式透露其售价。

paragraphs.en: The PlayStation 6 hasn't even been announced yet, but little rumors pop up now and then that add speculation on what to expect from Sony's next-gen console. The latest is a shocking claim that the RAM and storage configuration of the console will cost more than the entirety of the PS5.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼甚至还没有公布PlayStation 6，但有关这款次世代主机的传闻时不时就会冒出来，引发外界对其配置的猜测。最新的说法颇为惊人：这款主机仅内存和存储的成本，就将超过整台PS5。

paragraphs.en: Today's rumor comes via a long thread about next-gen hardware on NeoGaf , where known leaker Kepler_L2 simply said: "RAM + NAND alone is over $680." This was in response to another commenter who optimistically hoped that the console would come in at around $680. But, if Kepler_L2's numbers are right, and you should take them with a grain of salt, there's little chance of that happening.
paragraphs.cn: 今天的传闻来自NeoGaf上一个讨论次世代硬件的长帖。知名爆料者Kepler_L2在帖中只说了一句：「光是内存加NAND闪存就超过680美元(约合人民币4549元)。」另一位网友此前乐观地希望这款主机售价能在680美元(约合人民币4549元)左右，Kepler_L2的这句话正是对此的回复。不过，如果Kepler_L2给出的数字属实，这种定价就几乎不可能实现。当然，这些数字仍需谨慎看待。

paragraphs.en: This isn't the first time that Kepler_L2 has shared the leaked manufacturing cost of the PS6. Back in March, elsewhere on NeoGaf , they suggested the BoM (Bill of Materials) for the PS6 would be $760. But, due to the ongoing RAM crisis, they amended that estimate by saying the cost has gone up by around $200 in June. That would leave an estimated BoM of $960, which doesn't take into consideration additional costs like R&D, marketing and shipping. Keep in mind, though, that Sony has yet to say anything official about the price of PS6.
paragraphs.cn: 这不是Kepler_L2第一次爆料PS6的制造成本。早在3月，他们就在NeoGaf的另一处帖子中称，PS6的物料清单（BoM）成本将为760美元(约合人民币5084元)。但由于内存危机持续，他们在6月修正了估算，称成本已上涨约200美元(约合人民币1338元)。如此一来，物料成本估计将达到960美元(约合人民币6422元)，而这还没有计入研发、营销和运输等额外成本。不过要记住，索尼尚未正式透露任何有关PS6售价的信息。

paragraphs.en: However, while the presumed cost of the RAM and SSD are high, the rest of the console's hardware could be quite expensive, too. All of this speculation happened in a thread responding to previous speculation from Kepler_L2 that the PS6 would have a GPU with around 40 teraflops of compute performance, and Project Helix would be around 56 teraflops. Now, teraflops isn't the best predictor of gaming performance, but if these numbers are accurate, it would mean that the PS6 would be a little more than twice as powerful as the PS5 Pro, with a GPU that's roughly between the Radeon RX 9070 and Radeon RX 9070 XT.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，除了传闻中成本高昂的内存和SSD，这款主机的其他硬件也可能相当昂贵。上述猜测都出现在同一个讨论帖中，而这个帖子的起因，是Kepler_L2此前猜测PS6的GPU算力约为40TFLOPS，Project Helix则约为56TFLOPS。诚然，浮点算力并不是衡量游戏性能的最佳指标，但如果这些数字准确，PS6的性能将略高于PS5 Pro的两倍，GPU大致介于Radeon RX 9070与Radeon RX 9070 XT之间。

paragraphs.en: For reference, the Radeon RX 9070 costs around $900 right now, due to ongoing price increases, but even at launch it was still a $549 part. Part of that cost is made up of the VRAM, which would be accounted for in Kepler_L2's $680 figure, but the GPU itself is still a huge portion of the cost. Sony would likely get a discount for buying in bulk, but the chips powering the PS6 are probably still going to add a couple hundred dollars to the equation.
paragraphs.cn: 作为参考，由于价格持续上涨，Radeon RX 9070目前售价约为900美元(约合人民币6021元)，而它上市时的价格也有549美元(约合人民币3673元)。其中一部分成本来自显存，这部分应已计入Kepler_L2所说的680美元(约合人民币4549元)，但GPU本身仍占据很大一部分成本。索尼大批量采购很可能拿到折扣，不过PS6使用的芯片恐怕仍会让成本再增加约200美元(约合人民币1338元)。

paragraphs.en: I wouldn't be surprised, then, if the total cost of manufacturing the PS6 crosses the $1,000 or $1,100 mark. Sony has already suggested it won't sell the PS6 at a "significant" loss , so I doubt the company is going to slash hundreds of dollars off the price to move more consoles. So, if these leaked prices are accurate, I don't really see a world where the next-generation PlayStation sneaks in under $1,000, and we'd be lucky if we get it for under $1,200. I hope I'm wrong, though, I really do.
paragraphs.cn: 因此，即便PS6的制造总成本突破1,000美元(约合人民币6690元)，甚至1,100美元(约合人民币7359元)，我也不会感到意外。索尼已经暗示，不会以「大幅」亏损的方式销售PS6，所以我怀疑它是否会为了多卖主机，就将售价定得比成本低几百美元。因此，如果这些爆料中的价格准确，我实在看不到次世代PlayStation能把售价压到1,000美元(约合人民币6690元)以下的可能；能以低于1,200美元(约合人民币8028元)的价格买到，恐怕就算幸运了。不过，我希望自己猜错，真的。

paragraphs.en: But even though the PS6 is likely going to be very expensive, the company has been working overtime filing patents for some wild technology that may find its way into the PS6. Just last week, Sony filed a patent with its own take on frame generation , and before that filed another patent that would let games use player behavior to train NPCs .
paragraphs.cn: 不过，尽管PS6很可能相当昂贵，索尼一直在加紧为一些大胆的技术申请专利，而这些技术或许会用在PS6上。就在上周，索尼提交了一项采用自家方案的帧生成技术专利申请。在此之前，它还申请了另一项专利，让游戏能够利用玩家行为来训练NPC。

paragraphs.en: The company has also patented a technology that would turn your controller into an NFC card reader , and would use an AI agent to watch your console for hardware flaws, and deploy vibe-coded patches to fix problems before you even notice them.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼还为一项能将手柄变成NFC读卡器的技术申请了专利。此外，它还会利用AI智能体监测主机的硬件缺陷，并部署通过自然语言指令让AI编写的补丁，在玩家察觉之前就修复问题。

paragraphs.en: But don't hold your breath on a release date for the PS6. Following Sony’s shock decision to kill video game discs on PlayStation consoles from January 2028 , analysts predicted 2028 at the earliest, potentially the end of 2028.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，别急着等PS6的发售日期。索尼出人意料地决定，从2028年1月起终止PlayStation主机的游戏光盘。在此之后，分析师预测PS6最早也要到2028年才会发售，甚至可能要等到2028年底。
